digest.component_or_area: peer_confirmations.py and reconcile.py — snapshot-based link confirmation
propositions: A snapshot entry with issuelinks key present and a bound link produces a peer confirmation record with direction=snapshot, source=snapshot, link_id from raw entry, and current pass_id
A snapshot entry with issuelinks key absent (unobserved read) produces no confirmation record, even when the link is present and managed locally
An authoritative issuelinks=[] produces no confirmation record and does not remove or invalidate existing peer confirmations
Links with unbound source or target keys are skipped without raising an exception
Inbound link direction is correctly mapped through link_direction.resolve_inbound_link so Blocks inbound entries record as depends_on
